source.note: einboeck-rotarystar-en.pdf (Einböck ROTARYSTAR rotary hoe brochure), technical table p.5. The text layer has 9 data columns but only 7 type labels (300 340 500 600 640 900 1200); the columns were assigned by star count x 9.38 cm line spacing (32 stars = 3.0 m, 36 = 3.4 m, 54 = 5.0 m, 64 = 6.0 m, 68 = 6.4 m, 96 = 9.0 m, 128 = 12.0 m), which gives two transport-width versions each of the 900 and 1200. The 1200 (3.0 m) version is double-folding with electro-hydraulic sequence control. Working width (cm) equals the type number. The brochure states "Line spacing 9,38 cm / 36.93\"" (inch figure is a typo for 3.69\").
